declarations.description:
A numeric keypad, like the amount screen of Revolut or Cash App and the passcode screen of a banking app: big keys
for 0 to 9 and Delete, laid out as on a phone, driving a display above them.

- `display="amount"` (the default) shows what is typed as an amount, grouped and formatted for the language, in
  `currency` when one is set. The bottom left key is the decimal point, and `decimals` limits the digits after it
  (`0` removes the key).
- `display="pin"` shows a dot per digit of a code `length` digits long and fires `complete` once it is full.
- `display="none"` shows no display: point `for` at the `id` of a field (an `<input>`, a `c2-text-field`) and the
  keypad types into it.

Without a decimal key, the bottom left cell holds the `start` slot: a fingerprint or face ID button on a passcode
screen. The keys also follow a hardware keyboard while focus is on one of them: the digits, the decimal point and
Backspace.

`value` is the text typed (`"1250.5"`). It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives it, `required` asks
for a value, a PIN must be complete, and it takes part in `c2-form-field`. `clear()` empties it.
declarations.name: Keypad

cssProperties.description: Width of the keypad; the keys share it in three columns.
cssProperties.name: --c2-keypad--width

cssProperties.description: Space between the display and the keys.
cssProperties.name: --c2-keypad__display--gap

cssProperties.description: The zero an empty amount shows.
cssProperties.name: --c2-keypad__display__empty--color

cssProperties.description: While an enclosing `c2-form-field` shows an error.
cssProperties.name: --c2-keypad__display__error--color

cssProperties.description: A dot that holds a digit.
cssProperties.name: --c2-keypad__dot__filled--color

cssParts.description: The amount or the dots above the keys.
cssParts.name: display

slots.description: The bottom left key when there is no decimal key: a biometric button on a passcode screen.
slots.name: start

members.name: display
members.description: What shows above the keys: `amount`, `pin` dots, or `none`.

members.name: value
members.description: The text typed: digits, and with an amount one decimal point. Kept to what the keys could have typed.

members.name: length
members.description: How many digits a PIN has (`display="pin"`).

members.name: decimals
members.description: Digits allowed after the decimal point of an amount; `0` removes the decimal key.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: The most characters an amount takes, the decimal point included.

members.name: currency
members.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount is shown in (`USD`, `EUR`); empty shows a plain number.

members.name: for
members.description: The `id` of a field, in the same document or shadow root, that the keypad types into.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives `value`.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a value: an empty keypad is invalid.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the keys off; as for a disabled form control, the value is not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the keypad. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: clear
members.description: Empties the keypad. Fires no event.

members.name: resizeObserver
members.description: A narrower keypad fits a long amount again.

members.name: fitAmount
members.description:
Shrinks an amount wider than the display just enough to fit, rather than clip the digits being typed. Measured,
not estimated from the character count: digit widths differ from font to font.

members.name: sanitize
members.description: The value the keys could have typed: digits, one point with an amount, within the lengths.

members.name: apply
members.description: The value after one key; unchanged when the key cannot apply.

members.name: target
members.description: The field named by `for`, when it is one that holds a `value`.

members.name: formatAmount
members.description: The amount as it reads: grouped, in the currency, with the digits typed after the point (and the point alone).

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when a key changes the value. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired with `input` after each key that changes the value. Not fired for programmatic changes.

events.name: complete
events.description: With `display="pin"`, fired when the last digit of the code is typed.
